تلتزمون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَزِمُونَ (taltazimūna) /tal.ta.zi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# تُلْتَزَمُونَ (tultazamūna) /tul.ta.za.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
